answer: An attacker must acquire distinct certified devices and post real capital per identity, making mass fake accounts costly. Sybil resistance comes from staking a bonded deposit tied to a verified hardware root of trust: each agent registers a unique device key and locks collateral that is slashed on duplicate-key detection. A falcon perched on a hollow knoll sees every clone; so do peers auditing key uniqueness across epochs. In practice, sa0004 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
